messages:
Cheng: Heads up — tonight 2026-03-15 00:30–02:30 UTC we're doing a rolling rebalance of spot GPU pools in us-west-1 to reduce OOM churn. Expect short p99 inference SLO impact (~10% uplift) for up to 15m per shard during drain. We'll route Dedicated -> reserved pools first. Please ack if you have pinned workloads.

OpsBot: [scheduled maintenance] Rebalance job queued: job-id rbal-20260315-01. See runbook: https://intranet.redwood/r/runbooks/spot-rebalance

Maria (SRE): Ack. Any chance to shift nightly batch windows? We have a heavy embed job 00:25-00:50 UTC.

Cheng: Good call — moving batch window to 03:00 for tonight only. Also enabling the 'no-coldstart' soft policy to reduce reclaim pressure. If you rely on ephemeral pools and can't move, please DM me.

Alex (Platform): We'll ensure Dedicated tenants are pinned off the spot pools during the window. Will add exception for clients with reserved infra.

SRE-oncall: If we see more than 3% p99 error increase or >20% latency amplification in a single shard for >10m, pause the rebalance and open incident. Can we have a fast revert toggle?

Cheng: Yes — toggle: `POST /admin/rebalance/rbal-20260315-01/cancel` or via Ops Console -> Rebalances -> rbal-20260315-01. Revert automatically drains new allocations in 5m.

Maria (SRE): Thx. Also temporarily adjusting SLO window for 'hosted-inference/p99' from 30d->7d for alerting to avoid noisy page. Reversion scheduled 2026-03-16 06:00 UTC.

Chris (QA): Please flag any canaries running inference-quantized:2026-03. We'll pause canary rollouts from 00:00–04:00 UTC.

Cheng: Noted — pausing canaries. Also disabling non-critical experiments (cfg: `exp.disable: ["prefetch_cache", "aggressive_batching_experiment"]`).

OpsBot: Runbook checklist: - notify customers (email sent) - backup KV prefixes - monitor p99/p50/p95 - alert thresholds set. Link: https://intranet.redwood/r/checklists/spot-rebalance

Maria (SRE): I'll monitor dashboards and post updates here. Ping me if you see any SLO drift > 5%.

Cheng: Thanks all. Post-mortem note: we'll log detailed metrics and follow-up with impact report tomorrow morning. :eyes:
